description: This file defines a Java interface 'CustomerOptionSetService' for managing customer option sets in a sales management system. It declares service methods for saving, updating, and retrieving customer option sets based on store, option, and option value.

classes.name: CustomerOptionSetService
classes.description: A service interface for performing operations related to CustomerOptionSet entities, extending generic entity service functionalities.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves or updates a CustomerOptionSet entity, potentially throwing a ServiceException.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Retrieves a list of CustomerOptionSet entities associated with a specific MerchantStore and Language.

methods.name: listByOption
methods.description: Retrieves CustomerOptionSet entities associated with a specific CustomerOption and MerchantStore.

methods.name: listByOptionValue
methods.description: Retrieves CustomerOptionSet entities associated with a specific CustomerOptionValue and MerchantStore.
